site_description: TravelPlanner is a WeRoad-style group travel platform. Discover curated group trips, read reviews, find last-minute deals, and join a community of travelers.
hero_subtitle: Join curated group trips with like-minded travelers. Expert coordinators, handpicked destinations, unforgettable memories.
filter_subtitle: Filter by mood or season to discover trips made for you.
deals_subtitle: Limited spots at unbeatable prices. Book before they're gone!
trending_subtitle: Top-rated group trips handpicked by our community.
trending_no_trips: No trips yet. Check back soon!
how_subtitle: From inspiration to adventure, in five simple steps.
how_step1_desc: Filter by mood, season, or destination. Find the group trip that matches your vibe.
how_step2_desc: Book your spot. You'll travel with a small group of 10-15 like-minded people your age.
how_step3_desc: Your expert travel coordinator handles logistics so you can focus on the experience.
how_step4_desc: Flights, hotels, and activities booked through our partner links at the best prices.
how_step5_desc: Hit the road! Share your journey, leave reviews, and inspire the next group.
features_subtitle: Everything you need to plan, experience, and share your travels.
features_group_desc: Travel with 10-15 people your age. Make lifelong friends while exploring the world together.
features_coordinators_desc: Every trip has a local coordinator who knows the destination inside out. No stress, just adventure.
features_gallery_desc: Browse stunning photos from each destination. See what awaits you before booking.
features_reviews_desc: Real reviews from real travelers. See ratings, read stories, and book with confidence.
features_deals_desc: Grab discounted trips departing soon. Up to 30% off on selected departures.
features_community_desc: Join a community of adventurers. Share stories, get tips, and find your next travel buddy.
reviews_subtitle: Real reviews from our community of explorers.
partners_subtitle: We partner with the world's best booking platforms so you get the best prices without leaving TravelPlanner.
partners_flights_desc: Compare prices from 100+ airlines. Find the cheapest routes with our Skyscanner integration.
partners_hotels_desc: From budget hostels to luxury resorts. Book directly through Booking.com with best price guarantee.
partners_activities_desc: Skip-the-line tickets, guided tours, cooking classes, and unique local experiences.
partners_cars_desc: Compare rental prices across providers. Pick up at the airport, drop off anywhere.
pricing_subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready for more.
cta_subtitle: Join thousands of travelers who explore together, make friends, and create memories that last forever.
newsletter_subtitle: Join 10,000+ travelers. Weekly curated trips, last-minute deals, and community stories.
auth_login_subtitle: Log in to access your saved trips and premium itineraries.
auth_register_subtitle: Join TravelPlanner and start saving your favorite itineraries.
auth_banned_subtitle: Your TravelPlanner account has been suspended due to a violation of our community guidelines.
auth_banned_appeal: If you believe this was a mistake or would like to appeal, please contact our support team. We review all appeals within 48 hours.
faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about TravelPlanner.
faq_how_desc: TravelPlanner is a travel itinerary platform where you can browse expert-curated trip plans, save your favorites, and book flights, hotels, and activities through our trusted partners. We offer free itineraries for everyone, plus premium content for Explorer and Premium subscribers.
faq_creating_desc: Premium users can create custom itineraries from scratch using our drag-and-drop builder. Explorer users can duplicate and customize existing itineraries. All shared itineraries are reviewed for quality and accuracy before being published to the community. Please ensure your content is original, accurate, and helpful for fellow travelers.
faq_saving_desc: Free users can save up to 3 trips to their personal collection. Explorer and Premium subscribers enjoy unlimited saved trips. Saved trips are accessible from your "My Trips" page and can be removed at any time.
faq_community_desc: TravelPlanner is a collaborative community. To keep it helpful and safe for everyone, we ask all members to follow these rules:
faq_community_rule1: No spam or self-promotion. Do not post repetitive content, unsolicited advertisements, or affiliate links in itineraries or reviews.
faq_community_rule2: Provide accurate information. Ensure travel recommendations, prices, and logistics are up-to-date and truthful. Misleading information can ruin someone's trip.
faq_community_rule3: No advertising or commercial content. Itineraries and reviews should be genuine recommendations, not advertisements for specific businesses.
faq_community_rule4: Be respectful. Treat fellow travelers with courtesy. Offensive language, harassment, and hate speech are not tolerated.
faq_community_rule5: No personal contact information. Do not share phone numbers, email addresses, or external links in user-generated content.
faq_community_violations: Violations may result in content removal and account suspension. Repeated or severe violations may lead to permanent bans.
faq_account_rule1: One account per person. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent bans or free tier limits is prohibited.
faq_account_rule2: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure.
faq_account_rule3: Accounts that remain inactive for over 12 months may be archived.
faq_account_rule4: If your account is suspended, you may appeal by contacting support. Appeals are reviewed within 48 hours.
faq_swiss_desc: TravelPlanner is operated from Switzerland and complies with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDSG / revFADP), which came into force on September 1, 2023.
faq_swiss_rule1: We collect only the minimum personal data necessary to provide our services (email, name, saved preferences).
faq_swiss_rule2: Your data is stored securely on servers within Switzerland and the EU.
faq_swiss_rule3: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
faq_swiss_rule4: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time by contacting support.
faq_swiss_rule5: Affiliate click data is collected anonymously to improve partner recommendations.
faq_help_desc: Our support team is here to help with any questions, issues, or feedback.
